criteria.notes: Line andon: plant identity, aggregate stopped count, and per-station rows with state, station name, reason and elapsed time, grouped by line.
Andon-board concept retained: banner state summary over colour-coded station rows in a tall column format.
Reads as a factory andon column rather than a dashboard; the state banner and per-row colour field are domain-specific.
Station names and the aggregate banner hold their roles across both the 1080 and 480 wide columns; elapsed times sit at the metadata role by intent.

Light-theme scenario preserves state-colour separation across normal, attention and stopped rows without losing row banding. Station rows now pass the shared status-indicator conformance suite: each state is named in words, distinct states read distinctly, and the state text clears 3:1 against its own tint.
Long-reason scenario wraps the reason text within its row; station names stay complete at the 480px column width.
Rows fill the tall column at every count; the final-partial-group, invalid-rows and unknown-state scenarios stay balanced, and the empty state substitutes a centred no-status message.
Plant mark and state glyphs render crisply in both column widths; no raster media involved.
The tall single-column andon is structurally distinct from the landscape dashboard and grid examples.
